observation.failure: The pinned vLLM /v1/chat/completions/render endpoint rejected the preflight request with HTTP 400.

diagnosis.cause: The trace stores tools as a list of raw function-definition objects. The adapter wrapped a raw object only when trace.tools itself was an object, but passed list entries through unchanged. vLLM's ChatCompletionToolsParam requires every entry to have type=function and a nested function object.
evidence: The source trace's sole tools entry has name, description, and parameters keys but no type or nested function key.
The adapter's frozen _chat_tools implementation returned list-valued trace.tools unchanged.
Pinned vLLM 0.24.0 declares ChatCompletionRequest.tools as a list of ChatCompletionToolsParam, whose shape is type=function plus function=FunctionDefinition.
The request was rejected before the render handler returned token IDs and before any generation endpoint request.
diagnosis.what_failed: OpenAI request-schema construction for the authoritative renderer preflight.
diagnosis.what_did_not_fail: No tokenizer-equivalence check, replay pair, sampled continuation, reward comparison, or slicing comparison was attempted.
diagnosis.corrected_contract: Normalize each trace.tools entry independently: preserve already wrapped OpenAI function tools and wrap every raw function definition as {type: function, function: definition}. Also preserve HTTP error bodies in future diagnostics.

decision: Do not count this as a replay result and do not retry the frozen workload.
next_action: Fix and CPU-test per-entry OpenAI tool wrapping, improve HTTP error-body capture, then freeze a distinct no-retry micro-campaign.
